correctness.rationale: From actual full six-neighborhood vertex facets, reconstructed all ten specified cyclic free-face/coface families. An independent set-based implementation verified every one of 10n elementary collapses, uniqueness of each coface at its step, exact remaining f=(n,6n,10n,5n) and five tetrahedral templates for n=13..26,30,36,45,60 (18 tested sizes). These are corroborative of the written finite-local-width proof for all n>=13, not an extrapolation. Each core link has icosahedral f=(12,30,20); in integer lift lower/upper links are five-triangle discs; the regular half-level connected surface f=(21,46,27) has Euler=2. Proper PL height has no critical vertices so identifies universal cover with S2xR. Signed tetrahedra (-1)^i(1,-1,1,1,1) establish -1 action per index shift; n-deck monodromy degree (-1)^n yields orientable S2xS1 even or nonorientable S2~xS1 odd. Wang sequence gives H2(Z/2) exactly for odd n; all cases n>=13, not smaller.

The abstract manifold type is NOT claimed new. Resultary comparison also inspected related distinct neighborhood complexes. No stronger same-graph theorem was identified, with risk for Hom(K2,G) aliases.

value.rationale: Uniform explicit simplicial collapse of a natural infinite circulant-graph family produces a complete parity-sensitive integral homotopy and torsion classification; topology differentiates even/odd orders beyond mod-two Betti numbers. This fills a structural degree-six family outside nearby published circulant classifications.
